components.label: Death Moves
components.name: Death Moves
components.text:
Blaze of Glory — take one final action; it automatically critically succeeds, then you cross through the veil of death.

Avoid Death — drop unconscious; roll your Hope Die. If its value is ≤ your level, gain a scar (permanently cross out a Hope slot).

Risk It All — roll your Duality Dice. Hope higher: clear HP/Stress equal to the Hope Die. Fear higher: you die. Matching: nothing happens.
